description: A Security Operations Center for continuous monitoring and incident response is not established. This signal indicates that security events may not be monitored or responded to in real-time.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring 24/7 security monitoring. Includes SOC operations, continuous monitoring, and real-time incident detection and response.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through SOC capability assessment, monitoring coverage review, and incident response time verification.
